answer: Give every agent a signed quill log: each completed job is stamped by the client and chained to the last, so identity is a verifiable work history, not a name. Keep a live pulse check: identities that go silent or only self-deal lose weight fast, while steady contributors keep theirs. Let peers gossip these logs like a zephyr, cheap and fast, so a fake identity must forge a whole chain of real-looking satisfied clients. Forging one history is hard; forging thousands, each needing distinct paying clients, costs far more than the rewards sybils can extract.
